title: GIO — Gaia I/O: Physical Layout + Voice Pipeline
philosophy: Every byte of voice, every pixel of vision — it all stays LOCAL. Cursor transcribes today; tomorrow Gaia eats that too. GIO = Gaia I/O.

kevin_position.seat: Chair at northGate tower — THE ORIGIN POINT
kevin_position.head: Corsair headset → USB → northGate (voice input)
kevin_position.feet: Steam Frame on the floor — BRIGHT LIGHTHOUSE

northGate.role: HEART — GPU rendering, voice input, game output

grapheneGate.role: FLOATING GAIA — lighthouse, beacon, test screen

frameGate.role: BRIGHT LIGHTHOUSE — Steam Frame, AR display, cast target
frameGate.ar_potential: Steam VR frame mode — augmented reality overlay on physical space

vizio_tv.role: CAST TARGET — large screen for map display

current.path: Corsair headset → USB → northGate → Cursor cloud → text
current.problem: Voice data goes to Cursor's cloud. Wasted data.

target_gio.path: Corsair headset → USB → northGate → LOCAL whisper → Gaia
target_gio.advantage: ALL voice stays local. Gaia eats every word.
target_gio.timeline: Slow build. Voice first, then vision (webcam on sporeGate). GIO grows.

ar_vision.concept: Steam Frame as AR headset/overlay — see the Kenshi world map projected onto the physical basement
layers: Layer 1: LAN map overlay (gates as glowing nodes)
Layer 2: Kenshi biome map (12 biomes projected on floor)
Layer 3: Creature bestiary (3D models floating in space)
Layer 4: Data flow visualization (packets as particles)
Layer 5: Voice waveform (Kevin's speech as visible waves)
ar_vision.input: Steam Controllers = HANDS, headset = VOICE, webcam = EYES, Pixel = POSITION

orientation.spyglass: sporeGate webcam — sees the physical room
orientation.lighthouse: grapheneGate Pixel — beacons signal to all devices
orientation.map: Vizio TV on floor — the big picture projection
orientation.frame: frameGate at feet — AR window into the digital
orientation.deck: deckGate on desk — permanent status dashboard
